  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds because the GB-issued card was used from a US IP and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; no other rule holds, no household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Row §6.6(b) applies, but its required id_check has passed. Under §5.3(a), clear is mandatory and further friction is prohibited. A legitimate foreign-card customer with a billing discrepancy is now more plausible than stolen-card use.
